title: AquaPredict Milestone 7 Drainage-Informed Route Planner Metadata
disclaimer: RESEARCH & DEMONSTRATION PROTOTYPE — NOT A CERTIFIED NAVIGATION OR EMERGENCY EVACUATION SYSTEM

study_area.name: Downtown Houston / Buffalo Bayou Pilot Sector

cost_formulation.equation: Cost(e) = C_base * (1 + w_susc * EWSI) + P_depth + P_drain + P_uncert
cost_formulation.non_negative_guarantee: Cost(e) >= C_base > 0 for all edges under all scenarios and parameter values

base_travel_cost.definition: Geometric segment length in survey meters (derived from Shape.STLength)

terrain_susceptibility_factor.definition: 1.0 + (w_susc * EWSI_mean), where EWSI is the length-weighted continuous Exploratory Waterlogging Susceptibility Index [0.0 - 1.0]

modelled_depth_penalty.definition: Piecewise non-linear penalty based on maximum modelled ponding depth d_max from M5 simulation at selected preset and timestep

drainage_screening_penalty.definition: Screening penalty for proximity (< 25m street corridor) to M6 stormwater conduits with capacity exceeded (Qinflow > Qcap) or high loading

data_uncertainty_penalty.definition: Penalty applied when hydraulic information is missing or segment extends outside the 0.97 km² pilot grid. Missing data is never treated as evidence of safety.

speed_and_travel_time_assumptions.pedestrian_walking_speed_source: AASHTO / MUTCD default pedestrian walking speed standard (4.8 km/h, 3.0 mph)
speed_and_travel_time_assumptions.vehicular_speed_source: Municipal City of Houston SPEED attribute when present, defaulting to 30.0 mph for local streets

scientific_guardrails: Prototype Disclaimer: This route planner is an experimental research and demonstration prototype, NOT a certified navigation system or emergency evacuation service.
Relative Prototype Metric: The calculated hazard score is a relative multi-criteria screening metric, not a calibrated probability of flooding, property damage, or injury.
No Automatic Road Closure: Drainage capacity flags from M6 indicate subterranean hydraulic surcharge screening and must NOT be used to automatically declare streets closed.
Uncalibrated Model Outputs: M5 depth inputs are provisional simulation estimates from an uncalibrated 5% aggregate drawdown model and have not been validated against high-water marks.
Missing Data Governance: Missing terrain, depth, or drainage attributes are penalized as uncertain; missing data is NEVER treated as proof that a route is safe.
Strict Pilot Scope: Confined to the 0.97 km² Downtown Houston study domain. Extrapolation outside this boundary is unverified.
